findings.summary: The ASHRAE Handbook is a four-volume authoritative repository of practical knowledge on HVAC&R, published by the nonprofit ASHRAE society. It is released annually in print, CD-ROM, and a web-based electronic version updated yearly. Content is generated by volunteer technical committees and professional editors, following a four-year revision cycle where one volume is published each year. The work originated in 1922 and has undergone title changes and unit-version splits, establishing itself as a long-standing industry reference.

mechanisms.title: Volunteer-driven technical committee authorship
mechanisms.explanation: Chapters are created and modified by volunteers via ASHRAE's Technical Committees, then edited and formatted by professional staff.

mechanisms.title: Four-year publication cycle with annual volume release
mechanisms.explanation: Each chapter within a volume is reviewed and revised in a repeating four-year cycle; one volume is printed each year to keep the set current.
